finding: Black-first contact activated EB5 in all three repetitions and elicited MIDI from all four other nodes despite no direct contact with them. Stable paired-contact windows remained active in EB5; raw ADC-derived signal was at or near its zero rail. This does not establish zero signed analogue voltage or isolate the cause.
operator_observation: Al tocar el negro siempre empezó a sonar pero al tocar negro y planta no detecte un cambio bastante significativo qué diferenciará de solo negro
next_comparison: EB5 own pair, plant first then add black, with unchanged firmware and physical setup
limitations: Physical onset is operator-followed cue, not electronically instrumented.
Analogue scales are native firmware scales, not calibrated signed voltage.
MIDI note-duration estimate is not an audio recording.
Compare native sensor metrics within a node; installed firmware differs between nodes.
